checks: Full body/wrapper reviewed and syntax parsed; current owner, context/deadline/foregroundthread and goal/SERVERS integrity guarded.
SSH uses BatchMode/StrictHostKeyChecking with pinned remote hostname/uid1001 in body; full owner payload and exact body/wrapper/genuine peer hashes required.

Only four named kern.log/syslog current/dot1 files considered; existing regular no-follow readonly descriptors, at most128KiB each/512KiBtotal. No permission escalation or compressed/full-history traversal.
Only lines containing an exact target numeric PID token emitted, last8 perfile and768bytes perline; unfiltered surrounding or unrelated log lines are not emitted. WholeJSON capped32KiB.
Unique intent/result and uncertainty preservation; no journal/Apport/core/readelf retry, process query, signals, native/Torch/GPU, training, configuration or remote-file mutation.
Intent labels source/runtime/GPUUUID as immutable historical fields, runtime_or_GPU_testfalse and previous_owner_binding_renewedfalse; no present runtime identity/lease/execution is inferred.
limitations: PID token match alone does not establish historical process identity or fault attribution; retain source timestamps and independently correlate target/window. PID reuse or other numeric context cannot be ruled out by this filter.
Suffix coverage and timezone/year are not inferred; no match/access denial cannot prove no fault, and a reported object alone is not root cause.
Source review only; actual results and any faulting-object claim require separate review. Reviewer performed no SSH/execution/shared mutation, only this review write.
